paper.title: Performance of the MACE-MP-0 potential for calculating viscosity in LiF molten salt.

result.summary: 本文用 MACE-MP-0（small）机器学习势与经典 Buckingham、Born-Huggins-Mayer 势对熔融 LiF 进行分子动力学模拟，并用 Green-Kubo 方法计算黏度 [S2.p1]。结果显示 MACE-MP-0 开箱即用即可在整个液态范围内准确再现实验黏度，而经典势预测的黏度偏低 [abstract]。作者还发现，仅通过加热晶体结构得到的 MACE-MP-0 熔点显著更接近 LiF 的实验熔点 [abstract]。作者认为 MACE 势的动力学与经典势有定性差异，对准确模拟该体系不可或缺 [S4.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文关注熔融 LiF 的黏度这一热工水力工作流体的关键性质，此前经典分子动力学中 Buckingham 势预测的黏度存在明显的温度偏移，BHM 势仅略有改善 [S1.p3]。作者希望借助快速发展的机器学习原子间势改进对熔融 LiF 的分子动力学描述，并报告 MACE 势计算的黏度与实验数据的吻合程度 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: Viscosity is one key property governing the performance of working fluids in thermal hydraulics
the Buckingham potential model of molten LiF predicts the viscosity at a noticeable off-set temperature
Ciccotti et al. reported a slightly better agreement using the Born-Huggins-Mayer (BHM) potential
Motivated by these applications and a desire to improve the MD picture of molten LiF we now turn to the rapidly growing field of machine-learnt interatomic potentials (MLIPs).
Here we report the accuracy of viscosity values calculated using the MACE potential against experimental viscosity data.

method.text: 作者对熔融 LiF 进行分子动力学模拟：经典部分使用 Buckingham 和 BHM 势、通过 DL_POLY 包，机器学习部分使用 MACE_MP_0（small 版本）、通过 python 包 janus-core [S2.p1]。两种情况下都用 Green-Kubo 方法从应力自相关积分计算黏度，并同样利用 z-x 和 y-z 非对角项计算平均黏度 [S2.p1]。此外使用 python 包 ASE 计算偏径向分布函数 g(r)，进而计算结构因子 [S2.p1]。

evidence.quote: We perform MD simulations of molten LiF using classical MD (using the Buckingham and BHM potentials), via the DL_POLY package, and MACE MLIP, via the python package janus-core using MACE_MP_0 (small flavour).
In both cases we use the Green-Kubo method to calculate viscosity from the integral
We also compute the average viscosity utilising the other off-diagonal terms, $z-x$ and $y-z$, analogously to Equation 1.
We also use the python package ASE to calculate the partial radial distribution functions (RDFs), $g(r)$.

experiments.text: 模拟对象为熔融 LiF，分别用经典势（Buckingham、BHM，DL_POLY）和 MACE-MP-0（small，janus-core）进行分子动力学模拟，并用 Green-Kubo 方法计算黏度 [S2.p1]。作者还将 MACE-MP-0 通过简单加热晶体结构得到的熔点与 LiF 实验熔点进行比较 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: We perform MD simulations of molten LiF using classical MD (using the Buckingham and BHM potentials), via the DL_POLY package, and MACE MLIP, via the python package janus-core using MACE_MP_0 (small flavour).
We find that the melting temperature simulated by MACE-MP-0, simply by heating a crystal structure, is significantly closer to the experimental melting temperature of LiF.

findings.text: MACE-MP-0 开箱即用即可在整个液态范围内准确再现实验黏度，而此前经典势预测的黏度偏低，这此前被归因于被压低的熔点 [abstract]。仅通过加热晶体结构模拟得到的 MACE-MP-0 熔点显著更接近 LiF 的实验熔点 [abstract]。作者认为 MACE 势给出的动力学与经典势有定性差异，对准确模拟该体系不可或缺 [S4.p4]。MACE 势能更准确地再现熔融 LiF 的实验性质，但代价是相比经典两体势计算量增加 [S4.p1]。

evidence.quote: We find that the MACE-MP-0, out-of-the-box, is able to accurately reproduce the experimental viscosity across the liquid state.
Whilst the previous predicted viscosities from classical potentials are under-predicted, which has previously been attributed to a suppressed melting temperature.
We find that the melting temperature simulated by MACE-MP-0, simply by heating a crystal structure, is significantly closer to the experimental melting temperature of LiF.

The far superior prediction of the viscosity and melting temperature of LiF indicate that the dynamics resulting the MACE potential, which differ qualitatively from those of classical potentials, are indispensable to the accurate simulation of this system.
The MACE potential is able to more accurately reproduce experimental properties of molten LiF, but at the cost of an increased computational load versus classical two-body potentials.

limitations.text: 作者指出，分子模拟中熔点位置受多种因素影响：模拟体系常采用周期性边界条件，没有实验中的自由表面或界面来促进熔化；MD 体系尺寸比实验小，缺少能破坏固体结构、促进熔化的长波长和低频声子 [S3.p3]。因此，从晶体结构逐渐加热可能并不普遍准确地确定熔点，应改用计算固液相自由能、模拟相共存等方法 [S3.p3]。作者明确表示，本工作的目标和重点是输运性质（如黏度）的计算与预测，而非准确确定熔点，后者留待未来研究 [S3.p3]。

evidence.quote: simulated systems often employ periodic boundary conditions and hence have no free surfaces or interfaces, present experimentally, which promote melting
This leads to the absence of long-wavelength and low-frequency phonons with large displacement amplitudes which destabilise the solid structure and likewise encourage melting.
gradual heating from a crystal structure might not be generally accurate for determining the melting point

the goal and emphasis of this work is the calculation and prediction of transport properties such as viscosity rather than determining the melting point accurately which is a task for future investigations
